title: Evaluation of a truncated tree
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ coordinates with outputs in $\alpha$, let $a\in\alpha$ be a fallback value, let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. The evaluation of $T$ truncated at depth $k$ is either the evaluation of $T$ at $x$ or the fallback value $a$.
